description: Persona-pack open-source-maintainer: duty officer issues/PR (triage), reviewer of contributions from external contributors with severity-by gradation and verification supply-chain/commits, release manager SemVer (CHANGELOG, deprecation, announcement). The role is selected, not detected - stretches on top of any stack with a common PACK_PREFIX.

interview.q: Project agent name prefix (like a stack pack)?

notes.prerequisite: Role-pack, not tied to project_type and does not have detect — is selected explicitly as companion on top of the stack pack. PACK_PREFIX must match the stackpack prefix in order for @<prefix>-<role> resolved along with his roles.
notes.verify_workflow: All files are agents (.md), no work flow - node --check does not apply.
